title: TROLL_FACE_TOTEM
description: This beautiful, perfectly crafted, best and greatest resource pack changes the texture and sound of Totkm to wild trollface, giving you the strength to live on and degrade further.
body: This beautiful, perfectly crafted, and best resource pack changes the texture and sound of Totkmaz to a wild trollface, giving you the strength to live on and continue to degrade. Perhaps this trollface will give you strength during PvP and you'll win, but that's not certain. You can create a trollface room and use wild trollface there.
